End-to-end advisory and execution, under one roof.

HAYKALAH is a Saudi-born structuring house that has operated from Riyadh and Jeddah since 2004, and it designs, implements, operates and monitors what it structures. Its six practices serve five client groups, drawing on 22 years of structuring precedent codified into reusable playbooks and the HOAM screening matrix.

By practice

  1. 01

    Real estate structuring and execution

    Raw land to income-generating assets, through SPVs, capital stacks and fund vehicles.

    How we create value: Monetization, Optimization
  2. 02

    Family offices and sovereign partners

    Governance, succession and multi-jurisdictional continuity.

    How we create value: Monetization, Optimization, Transformation
  3. 03

    Strategic financial and capital structuring

    Sukuk, M&A, JVs, securitization and off-balance-sheet vehicles, under FINA.

    How we create value: Innovation, Optimization
  4. 04

    Venture building and execution

    HAYKALAH as institutional co-founder, from validation to capital readiness.

    How we create value: Innovation, Commercialization
  5. 05

    Digital transformation

    AI reporting dashboards, ERP and CRM automation, investment-platform architecture.

    How we create value: Innovation, Automation, Transformation
  6. 06

    Turning expenses into revenue

    Activate under-used assets, structure and operate them, and share in the revenue.

    How we create value: Monetization, Automation, Commercialization

Six ways we create value

Each practice draws on two or three of them; the practice cards above name which.

  1. 01

    Innovation

    New Shariah-compliant instruments, vehicles, operating models and digital tools, designed for the mandate in hand.

    Financial and capital structuring (FINA.)
  2. 02

    Monetization

    Idle land, buildings and facilities become income, refinancing capacity and capital to recycle.

    Turning expenses into revenue
  3. 03

    Optimization

    Highest-and-best-use studies, capital stacks weighed for cost, control and clarity, and competitive bank terms.

    Real estate structuring and execution
  4. 04

    Automation

    AI reporting dashboards, ERP, CRM and workflow automation, and digital records with a full audit trail.

    Digital transformation
  5. 05

    Transformation

    Governance, operating models, data rooms and AI dashboards that let decisions keep pace with capital.

    Family offices and trusts
  6. 06

    Commercialization

    Business models, operating companies and go-to-market plans that turn concepts into revenue.

    Venture building and execution
